title: Clockwork_recipes
description: Adds recipes to VS Clockwork for handheld drill and saw.
body: A small datapack to add recipes to Clockwork's handheld drill and saw, which are currently unobtainable in survival. Requires [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) and [VS Clockwork](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-clockwork). The tools can now be made with mechanical crafting and require precision mechanisms.
